messages:
Ivy (PM): Heads up 0 min sync: deciding where to surface spend vs token breakdown. Current options: compact org summary + project drawer OR full org page with inset project cards. Need quick takes.
Marco L.: For new users/org admins I think compact org summary first. Make project cards accessible via a right-side drawer that slides in.
Renee D.: Visualization concern: the stacked area for token types becomes illegible with >5 models. Propose replacing with horizontal stacked micro-bars per model and an expandable detail row.
Tom S.: Agree on micro-bars. Also propose a small interactive legend instead of hover-only tooltips. Legend items should be focusable and toggle series visibility.
Ivy (PM): Good. Where to put "Download statement"? Header primary action vs sticky per-project row?
Marco L.: Header primary + overflow menu on each project row. Keeps global action discoverable while allowing per-project exports.
Renee D.: Copy suggestion: primary = "Download statement (PDF)", overflow = "Download project statement (PDF)", separate "Export CSV" actions.
A11yBot: Accessibility checklist:
- Scope toggle must be keyboard reachable and announce state changes.
- Charts should provide a textual summary and CSV fallback.
- Legend toggles need aria-pressed and visible focus ring.
Tom S.: Performance: rendering 12 micro-bars client-side spikes paint time. Suggest server pre-compute svg sprite or render simplified canvases. Lazy-load details on expand.
BillingOps: Backend can provide per-project temp PDFs via presigned URLs, ETA 8 days once UX finalized.
Ivy (PM): Action items: Marco to produce two quick mocks (drawer vs inset); Renee to write copy strings and help tooltip text; Tom to sketch perf approach for charts; A11yBot to produce a short checklist. Devs to review once uploaded.
Marco L.: I'll drop Figma links here when ready.
Renee D.: Copy draft: "Download statement (PDF)"; help text: "Token breakdown shows model-level usage; costs are estimates until invoice finalization."
Tom S.: I'll add implementation notes about intersection observer lazy load.
A11yBot: I'll run a contrast check and keyboard flow script once mocks are in.
Ivy (PM): Thanks all 10. We'll aim for signoff by Thursday.
